resources.string: Look before you link. Scan QR codes and barcodes, then review them on your device.
Nothing is stored. In this version QR Shield does not keep a scan history; each scan is analyzed in memory and discarded when you leave the result.

QR Shield decodes the code on your device and checks the content with fixed rules: scheme, hostname, ports, look-alike patterns and more. Nothing is sent anywhere. The checks point out things worth a second look. They cannot prove a site is safe or harmful, and QR Shield never opens a link by itself.

What stays on your device

Barcode recognition (Google ML Kit, on-device) and all link analysis happen locally. QR Shield has no internet permission, no account, no analytics and no advertising.

Camera

The camera is used only while the scanner is open. Frames are analyzed in memory and are not saved or uploaded.

What is stored

Nothing. This version keeps no scan history. Decoded content exists only in memory while a result is shown. If you tap Copy, the text goes to the system clipboard, which other apps may be able to read.

Opening links

QR Shield never opens a link automatically. Opening is a separate action that shows the exact address first. Only http and https addresses can be opened, and your browser then connects to that site under its own privacy rules.

Limits

The checks are local heuristics with no reputation data. They can miss harmful links and can flag harmless ones.
